 By  Joe O'Neill-Parker , Robert Anderson Updated : Nov 16, 2026 1:39pm UTC Add IGN on Google 0 0 Black Friday is finally just around the corner. With that excellent news comes a raft of fantastic deals on PlayStation games and hardware . One of the best game deals we’ve found so far is Marvel’s Wolverine for just £39.99. The RRP for this one is at £69.99, so you’re saving yourself a very tidy £30. 
 This deal is from Amazon and is for a physical copy of the game. If you’ve been keeping tabs on this game but not been able to justify the £69.99 price tag, then now would be a good time to jump on this deal!

 I think it’s fair to say that the reaction to this game was initially mixed. Our own reviewer Simon Cardy praised the game for its characterisation of its protagonist , but criticised it for overly flashy combat that grew a bit tiresome as the game wore on. 
 There was also the rather amusing community backlash to the so-called “fart gas” scent trails in the game. Players didn’t like these for a number of reasons . First, they felt it was a little too hand-holdy, and their creative exploration was being stifled. Secondly, they just kind of…looked quite bad. 
 Thankfully, now we’re a few patches down the line, and Insomniac have allowed players to be able to toggle these hints on and off to their hearts’ content. 
 Fancy Some More PlayStation Deals?
 The savings in PlayStation goodies don’t end with this deal. DualSense controllers are £20 off, and you can also get £90 off a PlayStation VR2. If you’re after another incredible deal on a physical copy of a game, you can pick up Ghost of Yōtei for just £28 at the moment too.
 And, to top it all off, PlayStation Plus subscribers can get an additional 5% off accessories purchased directly through PlayStation, on top of the standard promotional discounts. That’s right, we’ve got deals on top of deals. 
 You can keep track of all the best PlayStation deals here over the Black Friday period. And, of course, keep following us for the best deals on games and tech.
